description: Add Jinja2-rendered HTML frontend pages for document workflow: login, dashboard, document viewer with annotations, review/approval workflow, cross-referenced document viewing, and user/role management (admin).
steps: Add dependency via 'uv add': jinja2. Run 'uv sync'.

Create app/templates/ directory structure: app/templates/base.html (base template with nav, CSS via Tailwind CDN, common JS), app/templates/login.html, app/templates/dashboard.html, app/templates/document_viewer.html, app/templates/workflow.html, app/templates/crossref.html, app/templates/admin_users.html.

Create app/templates/base.html: HTML5 base template with Tailwind CSS CDN, navigation bar (links to dashboard, workflow, admin if admin role), footer, flash messages area, block content placeholder. Include HTMX CDN for dynamic interactions.
Create app/templates/login.html: Login form (username, password), registration link. Form posts to /api/auth/login, stores JWT in localStorage, redirects to dashboard on success.

Create app/templates/dashboard.html: Shows documents organized by group/folder. Left sidebar with folder tree navigation. Main area shows document cards (filename, status, summary preview, upload date). Upload button per folder. Filter by status (uploaded/processing/processed/failed). Requires authentication.

Create app/templates/document_viewer.html: Full document viewer page. Left panel: rendered markdown content. Right panel: annotation sidebar (add/view annotations with text selection). Bottom: metadata (keywords, summary, processing status). Annotation form submits to an annotation API endpoint.

Create app/templates/workflow.html: Review/approval workflow page. Shows documents pending review in a queue. Each document has actions: Submit for Review (editor), Approve (approver), Reject with comments (reviewer), Request Changes (reviewer). Status badges showing workflow state. Filter by workflow status.

Create app/templates/crossref.html: Cross-referenced document viewer. Shows a document with its related/linked documents (from wiki entities/topics). Sidebar lists documents that share entities or topics with the current document. Click to navigate between related documents. Uses the wiki service to find cross-references.
Create app/templates/admin_users.html: Admin-only user management page. Table of users with their roles. Forms to assign/remove roles. Folder assignment management. Create new user form.

Create app/api/pages.py: HTML page route handler using Jinja2Templates. Routes: GET / (redirect to login or dashboard), GET /login (login page), GET /dashboard (dashboard page), GET /documents/{id}/view (document viewer), GET /workflow (workflow page), GET /documents/{id}/crossref (cross-ref viewer), GET /admin/users (admin user management). Mount static files if needed.

Create app/models/annotation.py: Annotation model (id, document_id FK, user_id FK, text, start_offset, end_offset, created_at). Create app/models/workflow.py: WorkflowAction model (id, document_id FK, user_id FK, action enum [submit_review, approve, reject, request_changes], comment, created_at).

Create app/api/annotations.py: POST /api/documents/{id}/annotations (create annotation), GET /api/documents/{id}/annotations (list annotations). Create app/api/workflow.py: POST /api/documents/{id}/workflow/submit (submit for review), POST /api/documents/{id}/workflow/approve, POST /api/documents/{id}/workflow/reject, GET /api/documents/{id}/workflow/history.
Create app/schemas/annotation.py and app/schemas/workflow.py with Pydantic models for request/response.
Update app/api/router.py to include pages_router, annotations_router, workflow_router.
Update app/main.py to mount Jinja2Templates directory.

Create tests/test_pages.py: Test that page routes return 200 with HTML content type. Test login page renders form. Test dashboard requires auth (redirects without token). Test admin page requires admin role.
Create tests/test_workflow.py: Test submit for review changes document workflow status. Test approve/reject actions. Test workflow history endpoint returns action log.
acceptance_criteria: GET /login returns an HTML page with login form
GET /dashboard returns HTML page showing documents (requires auth)
GET /documents/{id}/view shows document content with annotation UI
GET /workflow shows review queue with action buttons
GET /documents/{id}/crossref shows related documents from wiki
Annotation API allows creating and listing annotations on documents
Workflow API supports submit/approve/reject actions with role checks
All templates extend base.html and use Tailwind CSS
All existing tests pass plus new page/workflow tests pass
Running 'uv run ruff check app/ tests/' passes
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
